requirement: Recipient is a registered course participant
verification: Operator registers each participant in person at the service laptop; registry changes are refused (HTTP 403) from any other address. Code limits who can change the register, it cannot verify course membership. Verify: attempt registration from a phone on the Wi-Fi (expect 403) and record the in-person registrations

requirement: Consent timestamp scope and channel are retained
verification: recipients table stores consent_ts (Unix time, convert to UTC in the report), consent_version, channel and address; desktop tests pass. Verify: inspect the persisted record after a real registration

requirement: Active consent checked before every send and withdrawal enforced
verification: Consent re-checked immediately before each send; withdrawal before or during a dispatch stops later sends (desktop tests). Verify: withdraw a real recipient, raise an alert, confirm no message arrives

requirement: Provider choice justified against listed resources
verification: CallMeBot (listed on the card) is primary; ntfy (not listed) is a fallback. If ntfy is used, add the justification to the design rationale

requirement: No patient identifiers in payload or evidence
verification: Message texts are fixed per alarm class with no patient fields (desktop test). Verify: inspect the received messages on the phone and the stored deliveries rows

requirement: Provider acceptance and phone receipt recorded separately
verification: deliveries logs provider acceptance time and outcome; phone receipt time is recorded by hand during T08 against the logged time
